faq.label: Frequently asked questions
faq.title: Your questions about MYKEYNEST
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before getting started.

items.a1: It is a tool that stores and encrypts all your credentials in a secure digital vault. MYKEYNEST uses AES-256 encryption, the same standard used by banks.
items.a2: Stored credentials are encrypted with AES-256. Access is protected by account authentication, permissions and extension security controls.
items.q3: Is the free plan really free?
items.a3: Yes, no credit card required. You can use MYKEYNEST for free with basic features. The Pro plan unlocks advanced features.
items.q4: Can I use MYKEYNEST on multiple devices?
items.a4: Yes, your passwords are automatically synchronized across all your devices: computer, smartphone, and tablet.
items.q5: What is a hashed installation and how does it protect me?
items.a5: Every MYKEYNEST extension installation generates a unique cryptographic fingerprint tied to your instance. If an attacker tries to reuse your credentials on another device, the hash won't match and access is denied. If the extension is modified or corrupted, the integrity check fails and the vault locks automatically.
items.q6: What happens if I forget my master password?
items.a6: Use the “Forgot password” flow from the sign-in page. A reset link is sent to the email address associated with the account after the security checks.
items.a7: MYKEYNEST documents the data it processes, the purposes, service providers and your rights in its privacy policy. For a specific GDPR question, contact us at contact@key-nest.com.
items.a8: 2FA adds an extra layer of security: in addition to your master password, a temporary code is required at each login. Available via an authenticator app (TOTP) or email.

privacy.meta_description: Privacy policy for MYKEYNEST and its Chrome extension: processed data, purposes, permissions, retention and user rights.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy transparently explains how the MYKEYNEST service and browser extension process your data to secure, synchronize and fill your credentials.

controller.title: 1. Data controller
controller.text: %publisher% operates the %brand% service. For questions about your personal data or to exercise your rights, contact us at the address below.

purpose.title: 2. Extension single purpose
purpose.text: The MYKEYNEST extension lets an authenticated user access their vault, identify credentials matching the website being visited, and fill or submit a login form at their request. It also lets users manage authorized credentials from the extension interface.

data.title: 3. Data collected or processed
data.intro: Depending on the features you use, MYKEYNEST may process the following categories:
data.account: Account data: name, email address, organization, teams and information required for sharing.
data.authentication: Authentication data: extension access token, technical installation identifier and temporary pairing codes. The website session cookie is not sent to the extension.
data.vault: Vault data: service name, domain, username and password for entries your account is authorized to access.
data.browser: Browsing data required for the feature: active tab URL or domain and login-form structure. The extension locally detects login fields and does not read values you type.
data.technical: Technical and security data: browser and version, operating system, extension version, IP address, user-agent, pairing events and technical errors.

uses.title: 4. How data is used
uses.authentication: Authenticate the extension, associate an installation with the correct account and maintain the extension session.
uses.autofill: Find authorized credentials for the current domain, display them on request and perform autofill.
uses.sharing: Apply access rights, sharing rules and subscription-plan limits.
uses.security: Prevent unauthorized access, secure the service, investigate errors and detect abuse.
uses.support: Provide support, send communications essential to the service and comply with legal obligations.

permissions.title: 5. Extension permissions
permissions.intro: These permissions are used only for the disclosed MYKEYNEST features.
permissions.storage: Store the connection token, installation identifier and extension preferences locally.
permissions.tabs: Identify the active tab, determine its domain and open MYKEYNEST pages requested by the user.
permissions.notifications: Notify the user when a pairing step requires attention and the extension popup cannot be opened.
permissions.all_urls: Locally detect login forms and fill credentials on websites where the user chooses to use MYKEYNEST.
permissions.host: Communicate with the official MYKEYNEST API for authentication, vault access, authorization and extension pairing.

storage.title: 6. Storage and transmission
storage.local: The connection token, technical installation identifier and preferences are stored in the Chrome extension's protected local storage. During autofill after navigation, an entry identifier and username may be held in session memory for no more than two minutes.
storage.server: Account and vault data are hosted on the service infrastructure. Production communications between the extension and MYKEYNEST use HTTPS.
storage.passwords: Vault passwords are encrypted at rest on the server. The extension does not persist passwords: it retrieves them only when an authorized reveal or autofill action requires them.

sharing.title: 7. Recipients and service providers
sharing.no_sale: We do not sell or rent your data, use it for personalized advertising, or transfer it to data brokers.
sharing.hosting: %provider% for technical hosting and service storage.
sharing.email: Brevo for transactional and security emails.
sharing.billing: Stripe for payments and subscription management; MYKEYNEST does not store full payment-card numbers.
sharing.browser: Google Chrome and the Chrome Web Store for extension distribution and execution according to browser settings.
sharing.analytics: The extension itself contains no advertising or audience analytics. The public website may use separate audience measurement; this privacy page does not load it.

retention.title: 8. Data retention
retention.text: We retain data only for as long as necessary to operate the account, maintain security and meet legal obligations. The local token is deleted when the extension is disconnected; local installation data can also be removed through Chrome. Account data can be deleted on request, subject to retention required for law, billing or fraud prevention.

security.title: 9. Security
security.text: We apply appropriate technical and organizational safeguards, including encrypted communications, encryption at rest for vault secrets, access controls, installation pairing and restricting local storage to trusted extension contexts. No system can guarantee absolute security.

limited_use.title: 10. Chrome Web Store – Limited Use
limited_use.text: Data obtained by the extension is used solely to provide or improve its user-facing single purpose. It is not sold, used for advertising, transferred for credit assessment, or accessed by humans except with your consent, for security, support, legal compliance, or where the data is aggregated and anonymized.

rights.title: 11. Your rights
rights.text: Depending on applicable law, you may request access, correction, deletion, restriction or portability of your data and object to certain processing. You may also lodge a complaint with the competent data-protection authority.

changes.title: 12. Changes to this policy
changes.text: This policy may change when the service, extension or legal requirements evolve. The date displayed at the top of the page identifies the version currently in effect.

seo.title: How to create a truly secure password?
seo.intro: Online account security starts with long, unique and random passwords. Our free generator uses the browser’s Web Crypto API to create each combination.
seo.good_password_text: A secure password should combine several essential elements. It should be long enough (at least 12 characters), mix different character types (uppercase, lowercase, numbers and symbols), and above all be unique for each account.
seo.why_generator_text: Human-created passwords are often predictable and vulnerable. Our tool generates completely random passwords that provide optimal protection against brute-force attacks and hacking attempts. Each generated password is unique and cryptographically secure.
tips: Use a different password for each important account
Prefer passwords of at least 16 characters
Use a secure password manager like MYKEYNEST
Never share your passwords via email or SMS
seo.tech_text: Our generator uses your browser’s native Web Crypto API to produce truly random numbers. Unlike classic pseudo-random generators, this method guarantees maximum entropy and professional-grade cryptographic security.

items.q1: Are my passwords really secure with MYKEYNEST?
items.a1: MYKEYNEST protects vault secrets with encryption at rest, secures communications over HTTPS and applies access controls by account, share and organization. You should still use a unique main password and enable two-factor authentication when your plan supports it.
items.q2: Can I use MYKEYNEST on multiple devices?
items.a2: You can access the web application from authorized devices. The number of browser-extension installations depends on the plan and the rules configured for your organization.
items.q3: Does the password generator store my passwords?
items.a3: No. The generator runs entirely client-side using the browser's crypto.getRandomValues API. No data is sent to our servers. The password disappears as soon as you close the tab.
items.q4: How do I upgrade to Pro?
items.a4: From your personal space, go to Settings › Subscription and click “Upgrade to Pro”. Payment is securely handled by Stripe. Your account is upgraded instantly with no downtime.
items.q5: Where can I find privacy information?
items.a5: The public privacy policy describes the data processed by the service and extension, browser permissions, service providers, retention and your rights.

card1.text: Spreadsheets, emails, chat tools, and unmanaged browsers lead to untracked access, password reuse, and poor offboarding when employees leave.

card2.title: Access sharing must stay controlled
card2.text: SMBs need to hand over access quickly without exposing accounts. Secure sharing avoids sensitive credentials being sent through unsafe channels.

card3.title: SMB cybersecurity often starts with access control
card3.text: A compromised account often opens the door to phishing, fraud, or ransomware. An enterprise password manager helps secure this first critical layer.

steps.title: How to deploy an enterprise password manager without friction
steps.subtitle: The goal is not to change every habit overnight, but to build a secure baseline quickly.

step1.title: Map critical access points
step1.text: List the tools, shared accounts, cloud consoles, mailboxes, and sensitive access already used in the business.

step2.title: Centralize risky credentials first
step2.text: Start with exposed accounts: business tools, finance, hosting, marketing, support, and client environments.

step3.title: Define sharing and rotation rules
step3.text: Decide who can view, share, or rotate access in order to reduce gray areas and single-person dependencies.

q1.question: How long does an audit take?
q1.answer: A remote audit typically takes 2 to 3 business days. An on-site audit spans half a day to a full day depending on the size of your organisation. The report is delivered within 5 days of the engagement.

q2.question: Do I need MYKEYNEST to benefit from the audit?
q2.answer: No. The audit and training are offered independently of our software. Of course, if the audit reveals password management issues, we can propose MYKEYNEST as a suitable solution.

q3.question: Is the training suitable for non-technical employees?
q3.answer: Absolutely. Our training is designed for non-technical profiles: sales, HR, accounting… We use real-world examples from your sector to maximise understanding and retention.

q4.question: What is the cost of an audit?
q4.answer: The price varies depending on the scope and size of your company. Contact us for a free personalised quote. As a MYKEYNEST Pro customer, you benefit from a built-in software security audit at no extra cost.
